topic: Smart Beta, Quant Funds and other Non-Traditional Index Funds
source_evidence: Different indexes may include the same securities. Or, indexes could give more weight to certain securities than you might expect.
answer: When you hold multiple non-traditional index funds, their indexes may include some of the same securities. That overlap can make your holdings less diversified than the number of funds suggests. Also check how much weight each fund gives to particular securities: several funds may collectively leave you more exposed to certain holdings than you expect. Looking through each fund’s actual holdings can help you assess overlap and concentration.
